worldFact.fact: Every five to seven years, Merina families in Madagascar's central highlands open their ancestral crypts, unwrap their dead, rewrap them in fresh silk shrouds and then party with them, drinking, talking and dancing with the bodies. Before sunset the dead are returned to the tomb, which stays sealed for another five to seven years.
